class TaskC {
    long[] a = new long[17];
    HashMap<Long, Long> memo = new HashMap<Long, Long>();

    public long solve(int n) {
        a[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i-1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        return calc(n);
    }

    long calc(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        if (memo.containsKey(n)) return memo.get(n);

        Stack<Long> stack = new Stack<Long>();
        HashSet<Long> onStack = new HashSet<Long>();
        stack.push(n);
        onStack.add(n);

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            long cur = stack.peek();
            if (cur == 0) {
                memo.put(0L, 0L);
                stack.pop();
                onStack.remove(cur);
                continue;
            }
            if (memo.containsKey(cur)) {
                stack.pop();
                onStack.remove(cur);
                continue;
            }
            int i = 0;
            while (a[i] < cur) i++;
            if (a[i] == cur) {
                memo.put(cur, (long)i+1);
                stack.pop();
                onStack.remove(cur);
                continue;
            }
            long k1 = cur / a[i-1];
            long rem1 = cur - a[i-1] * k1;
            long k2 = (a[i] - cur) / a[i-1];
            long rem2 = a[i] - a[i-1] * k2 - cur;

            boolean rem1Ready = memo.containsKey(rem1);
            boolean rem2Ready = memo.containsKey(rem2);

            if (rem1Ready && rem2Ready) {
                long c1 = i * k1 + memo.get(rem1);
                long c2 = i + 1 + i * k2 + memo.get(rem2);
                long min = Math.min(c1, c2);
                memo.put(cur, min);
                stack.pop();
                onStack.remove(cur);
            } else {
                if (!rem1Ready && !onStack.contains(rem1)) {
                    stack.push(rem1);
                    onStack.add(rem1);
                }
                if (!rem2Ready && !onStack.contains(rem2)) {
                    stack.push(rem2);
                    onStack.add(rem2);
                }
            }
        }
        return memo.get(n);
    }
